modelAnswer.description: …Open A Checking Account With BR Telco & Earn Up To 5.5…

notes: The uncut ad reads 'Earn Up To 5.55% APY*'. So this is neither a bonus nor 5.5 of anything, and it produced '2 of 3 competitors advertise cash bonus' about a competitor advertising no bonus. GROUNDED (it was on screen) and INCOMPLETE (the digits are not). The parsed value is null, not 5.5: num() will not read a percent without a % or a dollar figure without a $, which is the same refusal isCompleteFigure() makes and the right one. The corpus said 5.5 and the corpus was wrong.
